documents.title: Clarification sought from California Software Company Ltd
Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On July 20, 2026

analysis.summary: In FY 2024-25, California Software Company Limited focused on democratizing artificial intelligence for small and microbusinesses through its platforms dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo. The company aimed to bridge the resource and expertise gap for small enterprises by providing affordable, no-code, and AI-driven solutions for e-commerce, marketing, and financial management. Management reported robust user growth and high client retention, emphasizing that their strategy aligns with global trends of increasing AI adoption among small firms. The company also integrated generative AI and blockchain-based financial tools to enhance operational efficiency and resilience for its clients. California Software Company Limited is focusing on empowering small businesses by integrating disruptive technologies like AI, blockchain, and cloud computing into its service offerings.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed a significant surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally, with approximately three-quarters of small firms expected to be AI-powered soon.
demand_outlook.quote: The past year witnessed an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally. About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior. An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to the needs of small businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented affordable pricing models, such as a $10 per month entry plan for dRyZe CRM, to remove price barriers for micro-businesses.
margins_costs.quote: For example, dRyZe CRM’s entry plan was set at just $10 per month for up to 5 users, deliberately removing the price barrier that had long prevented micro-businesses from using sophisticated CRM tools.

orders_capacity.claim: The dSpeedUp platform grew to serve over 1000 merchants with a 95% annual client retention rate.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises face significant resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
